messages.subject: Unable to initialize Postgres Instance
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

As part of one of my project, I am using Renjin to interpret my R scripts. I have to connect to a Postgres instance. I am providing the following snippet in my maven xml file
<dependency>
   <groupId>org.renjin.cran</groupId>
   <artifactId>RPostgreSQL</artifactId>
   <version>RELEASE</version>
</dependency>
When I Import the library in R as follows, and try to initialize the driver

library(RPostgresSQL)
drv<-RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL()

I get the following error

org.renjin.eval.EvalException: object 'RS_PostgreSQL_init' not found

Is there anything different that needs to be done?

Best,
Ekaansh Anand | 

messages.subject: Re: Unable to initialize Postgres Instance
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ekaansh,

The RPostgreSQL package depends on the external postgres native client
library, so it can't be used with Renjin. We had started a drop-in
replacement based on RJDBC, but it's not finished, so your best best
it use RJDBC directly. Add the following dependencies to your project:

<dependency>
   <groupId>org.renjin.cran</groupId>
   <artifactId>RJDBC</artifactId>
   <version>10.0.14/version>
</dependency>

<dependency>
   <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
   <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
   <version>9.4-1200-jdbc41</version>
</dependency>

And then you can connect to your database in the following manner:

library(DBI)
library(RJDBC)

drv <- JDBC("org.postgresql.Driver")
con <- dbConnect(drv,
url="jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/renjintest", user="renjin",
password="renjin")

print(dbReadTable(con, "testtable"))

I've tested the code above very quickly against a local PostgreSQL
server, but if you run into any problems let me know.

Best,
Alex
